ai: At first, I could not understand a single word he said.
起先，我連他說的一個字都聽不懂。
The water felt cold at first, but we soon got used to it.
水起先感覺很冷，但我們很快就習慣了。
At first she was shy, but now she talks to everyone.
她起先很害羞，但現在跟每個人都聊得開。
Please book your tickets in advance to get a better price.
請預先訂票才有比較好的價格。
Thank you in advance for your help with the project.
先謝謝你對這個專案的幫忙。
We told the teacher in advance that we would be late.
我們事先告訴老師我們會遲到。
In general, people in this city go to bed quite late.
一般來說，這座城市的人睡得相當晚。
The movie was good in general, but the ending was weak.
這部電影大致上不錯，只是結局很弱。
Students in general prefer short tests to long essays.
學生大致上比較喜歡短測驗而不是長篇報告。
I like fruit, mangoes in particular.
我喜歡水果，特別是芒果。
Is there anything in particular you want for dinner?
晚餐你有什麼特別想吃的嗎？
The teacher praised one student in particular for her effort.
老師特別稱讚其中一位學生的努力。
In addition, the hotel offers free breakfast to all guests.
另外，這間旅館提供所有住客免費早餐。
The job pays well, and in addition, the hours are flexible.
這份工作薪水不錯，另外上班時間也很彈性。
In addition to English, she speaks Japanese and French.
除了英文，她還會說日文和法文。
A tall man was standing in front of me in line.
一位高個子男士排在我前面。
The children played in front of the school after class.
孩子們放學後在學校前面玩耍。
Please don't park your car in front of my gate.
請不要把車停在我家大門前面。
In spite of the rain, we had a great picnic.
儘管下雨，我們還是野餐得很開心。
He went to work in spite of his bad cold.
儘管重感冒，他還是去上班了。
In spite of her fear, she walked onto the stage.
儘管害怕，她還是走上了舞台。
In terms of price, this phone is a good choice.
就價格而言，這支手機是不錯的選擇。
The two cities are very different in terms of weather.
這兩座城市在天氣方面差很多。
We should think about the plan in terms of time and cost.
我們應該從時間和成本方面來思考這個計畫。
I would like to thank you on behalf of the whole team.
我想代表整個團隊向你道謝。
She accepted the prize on behalf of her class.
她代表全班領了這個獎。
The manager spoke on behalf of all the workers.
經理代表所有員工發言。
I drank tea instead of coffee this morning.
我今天早上喝了茶而不是咖啡。
Let's walk instead of taking the bus today.
我們今天走路吧，不要搭公車。
Instead of watching TV, he decided to read a book.
他決定看書，而不是看電視。

rather than.zh: 而不是（A rather than B＝是 A 而不是 B）
ai: She chose a quiet job rather than a stressful one.
她選了一份安靜的工作，而不是壓力大的工作。
I prefer to cook at home rather than eat out.
我比較喜歡在家煮飯，而不是出去吃。
The problem is the schedule, rather than the people.
問題出在時程，而不是人。
Rather than complain, why not try to fix it yourself?
與其抱怨，何不自己試著修好它？
Rather than wait for help, he decided to start working.
他決定與其等人幫忙，不如自己動手做。

according to.zh: 根據, 按照；取決於；據…所說
ai: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
根據天氣預報，明天會下雨。
According to my sister, the new cafe is really good.
據我姊姊說，那間新咖啡店很不錯。
Everyone must follow the rules according to the instructions.
每個人都必須按照說明遵守規則。
Apart from Tom, everyone came to the party.
除了湯姆之外，每個人都來參加派對了。
Apart from a small cut, he was not hurt at all.
除了一個小傷口之外，他完全沒受傷。
The room is empty apart from a bed and a desk.
這個房間除了一張床和一張書桌之外什麼都沒有。
Don't be angry with him; he is only a child after all.
別對他生氣，畢竟他只是個孩子。
You should rest today. It is Sunday after all.
你今天該休息了，畢竟今天是星期天。

after all.zh: 終究、結果還是（與預期相反）
ai: We thought it would rain, but the sun came out after all.
我們以為會下雨，結果太陽還是出來了。
She decided to join the trip after all.
她終究還是決定參加這趟旅行。
The test was easy after all, so I did not need to worry.
這次考試結果還是很簡單，我根本不必擔心。
Please call me right away if you have any problem.
如果有任何問題，請立刻打電話給我。
I will send you the file right away.
我馬上把檔案寄給你。
The doctor came right away after we called him.
我們打電話後，醫生立刻就來了。
Let's take a break and have some tea.
我們休息一下，喝點茶吧。
You have been studying for hours. You should take a break.
你已經讀書好幾個小時了，應該休息一下。
They took a break from work to eat lunch outside.
他們暫停工作，到外面吃午餐。
Please pay attention to what the teacher is saying.
請專心聽老師說的話。
He didn't pay attention and missed the turn.
他沒專心，結果錯過了轉彎處。
You need to pay attention when you cross the road.
過馬路時你必須專心注意。
I am slowly getting used to the cold weather here.
我正慢慢習慣這裡的寒冷天氣。
She got used to waking up early for work.
她習慣了為了上班早起。
It takes time to get used to a new school.
適應新學校需要時間。
The movie was about to start when we arrived.
我們到的時候電影即將開始。
I was about to leave when the phone rang.
電話響的時候，我正要出門。
Hurry up! The train is about to leave.
快點！火車就要開了。
He was supposed to turn off his phone in class.
他上課時本來應該把手機關掉。
I was supposed to meet him at six o'clock.
我本來應該六點跟他碰面。
She was supposed to bring the form, but she forgot.
她應該要帶那張表格，卻忘了。
